Splitting behaviour: Exactly one outgoing path is taken, based on a condition
Velora example: Customer on trusted list? yes or no

Splitting behaviour: All outgoing paths are taken at the same time
Joining behaviour: Waits until all incoming paths have arrived
Velora example: Send confirmation and schedule production at the same time

Splitting behaviour: One or more paths are taken, each with its own condition
Joining behaviour: Waits for all paths that were actually started
Velora example: Notify Sales and/or Key Account Manager

Splitting behaviour: The path depends on which event happens first
